ManualLayout.metaDescription: Looking for a way to handle a lost, found, or stolen item? We've organized the reporting steps and contacts by type so you can stay calm and act with confidence.

policeRecord.title: Have you checked the police lost-item records?
policeRecord.content: Check the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr/) for lost items currently held by the police.

lostPost.title: Have you posted a lost item listing?
lostPost.content: Post a lost item on Finditem so whoever found it can reach out to you through your listing.

policeFoundList.title: Have you checked the police found-item list?
policeFoundList.content: Check the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr/) for lost items currently held by the police.

creditCard.title: Did you lose a credit card?
creditCard.content:
If you lose a credit card, report it to the card issuer right away.

If you've lost multiple cards, you can use the integrated card-loss reporting service — reporting to just one issuer's customer center will register the loss with the other issuers too.



Corporate cards can't be reported through the integrated service even if issued under an individual's name, so they must be reported separately.

idCard.title: Did you lose your ID?
idCard.content:
For a resident registration card, visit your nearest community center in person, or file an online report at Minwon24 (www.minwon.go.kr).



If you lost your driver's license, visit a nearby police station or driver's license test center to report the loss and apply for reissue.

phone.title: Did you lose your phone?
phone.content:
Report the loss and suspend the line through your carrier's customer center (114), an authorized store, or the carrier's website.



You can also search for found phones through the Phone Finder Call Center (https://www.handphone.or.kr).

policeRecord.title: Have you checked the police lost-item records?
policeRecord.content: Check the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr) for items reported as lost.

foundPost.title: Have you posted a found item listing?
foundPost.content: Post a found item on Finditem so whoever lost it can reach out to you through your listing and reclaim it.

foundReport.title: Have you reported the found item?
foundReport.content: If you've found an item, you can report it through the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr) or at your nearest police station.

policeItems.title: Have you checked the police found-item list?
policeItems.content: Start by checking the National Police Agency's Lost112 portal (https://www.lost112.go.kr) for items currently held by the police.

cctv.title: Want to check CCTV footage?
cctv.content:
Visit your nearest police station to file a theft report, then request CCTV access directly from whoever manages the location where the theft occurred.



For CCTV in public spaces, you can request access by filing an information disclosure request through the Information Disclosure Portal (https://www.open.go.kr).
cctv.btnText: Go to the Information Disclosure Portal
